title: Pluto TV to broadcast VMA 2026 live in Brazil
seoTitle: Pluto TV Broadcasts VMA 2026 Live in Brazil Free
subtitle: The platform offers free streaming of the MTV awards show in Brasília time
excerpt: Pluto TV will broadcast the MTV Video Music Awards 2026 live in Brazil, allowing the public to watch the ceremony for free starting at 8:30 PM.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Madonna's return to the MTV Video Music Awards stage after 23 years and the presence of artists like Taylor Swift, Snoop Dogg, and Lisa have generated great anticipation for the 2026 edition. Therefore, the live broadcast of the awards show has become a major topic among Brazilians looking to follow the event.

Pluto TV offers free streaming in Brazil

According to coverage by Estadão, the ceremony will be broadcast live in Brazil by Paramount+ and Pluto TV, starting at 8:30 PM (Brasília time). The same information appears in an article by CNN Brasil, which confirms the free broadcast on Pluto TV.

Schedule and broadcast channel

VMA 2026 begins at 7:30 PM US Eastern Time, which corresponds to 8:30 PM in Brasília. The live broadcast will be handled by CBS and MTV Brasil, with Pluto TV making the signal available at no charge.

How to access the broadcast

To watch, simply access Pluto TV on internet-connected devices, such as smartphones, tablets, smart TVs, or computers. No paid registration is required; the platform offers the content within its free catalog.

Relevance of the broadcast for the Brazilian public

The free availability broadens music fans' access to the event, allowing them to follow unprecedented performances, such as the television debut of "SaWaDiKa" by Lisa, and tributes to established artists. The broadcast also ensures the public gets to see performances by Brazilian artists, like Anitta, competing in the Best Latin category.

Other replay options

For those unable to watch live, the ceremony will be available the following day, September 28, on the Paramount+ platform. Thus, the public has the chance to rewatch the night's most memorable moments.

With information from Estadão, CNN Brasil.
